AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: kiiro village children
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] grew up in a village inhabited by kiiro. Like every ordinary kiiro child, [PAWN_nameDef] had a complete and happy childhood.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: kiiro good student
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] loves learning and is well liked by the teachers at school.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: kiiro tractable child
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] learned early to be frugal and often did chores around the house that she could.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: kiiro farm child
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.baseDesc: Instead of getting an education like the rest of her peers, [PAWN_nameDef] chose to stay home and help take care of the farm.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: kiiro shepherd child
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] enjoys spending time with animals. Despite her young age, she has become a reliable herder. [PAWN_nameDef] can sing some pastoral songs.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: kiiro paper art apprentice
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] has been learning paper art since she was young. Her master wanted her to pass on this craft.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: kiiro autistic child
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] is afraid of interacting with people and is always solitude in her room. Being alone gives her a lot of time to think on her own, so maybe [PAWN_nameDef] more deliberate than her peers?

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: kiiro orphan
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] grew up relying on the kindness of others; [PAWN_nameDef]'s loved ones left her forever in a disaster when she was young. But after a period of struggle she regained her strength: what does not defeat her will eventually make she stronger.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: kiiro imp
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] is energetic, although her vivacity always brings trouble to those around her.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: kiiro bookworm
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] loved to read books, and she spent all her free time into them, into those endless, varied worlds.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: kiiro blacksmith apprentice
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] grew up following around an experienced blacksmith doing some odd jobs. Whenever [PAWN_nameDef] was enthralled by the iron born from the flames and asked her master when she could do it herself, her master would always shudder at the memory of the hammer that [PAWN_nameDef] once almost swung to her head.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: kiiro wretch
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] always experienced some unlucky things in her childhood, and it seemed that everything was not going well with her, but after getting used to such a life, [PAWN_nameDef] turned out to be an optimistic person instead.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: kiiro left behind child
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.baseDesc: Both of [PAWN_nameDef]'s parents left her when [PAWN_nameDef] was young, and [PAWN_nameDef] doesn't know where they all went, but [PAWN_nameDef] looks forward to their return every day.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: kiiro town child
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] grew up in a town where the level of technology was booming, and the constant introduction of new things fascinated [PAWN_nameDef] all the time, which made her extremely interested in them.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: kiiro little genius
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] has shown exceptional intelligence since she was young, and her quick and precise logical thinking has always drawn praise from those around her.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: kiiro newsy
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] often helps deliver newspapers for a newspaper office in a small town as a way to get some extra pocket money. Sometimes [PAWN_nameDef] also reads the newspaper by herself, and she learns a lot of things from it that she cannot usually touch.
